text:
The lands within the prescribed project are situated along the Bighorn River, Little Bighorn River, Pryor Creek, and Lodge Grass Creek, which are all tributary to the Yellowstone River. There are nine project-operated units scattered over an area roughly 50 miles by 60 miles in size. The lands contained within the project may be categorized as follows:
